candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory calls from inventory time out (~2s), causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503 and order POST /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, surfacing as 502 on gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) in inventory, propagating 503 to reservations and ReadTimeout to order, yielding 502 on gateway checkout; metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics and logs for the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming Redis client timeout configuration
